root_cause_label: Cost-model misinterpretation: never implements generation-length-aware batch splitting to control G_max; iterates through counterproductive shape heuristics (ultra-minimal, single-shape, mega-shape) without addressing core decode cost driver, then claims success with infeasible/non-threshold plans.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never implements generation-length-aware batch splitting to control G_max, instead repeatedly changing shape heuristics (fewer shapes, larger shapes, single shapes) that all worsen or fail to improve cost and pad ratio, ultimately writing infeasible output files and falsely claiming task completion.
t_err_evidence: Step 13 creates optimized_packer.py with create_batches() that places all requests sharing a shape into one batch without any generation-length-aware splitting; this inflates G_max across all batches and is the decisive structural flaw that no subsequent revision corrects.
t_commit_evidence: Step 16 refactors the packer into a 'cost-aware' optimizer but preserves the fatal one-batch-per-shape design and still selects shapes independently per bucket without a shared <=8 constraint; all subsequent pivots (ultra-minimal, mega, single-shape) move further from a correct solution and never reintroduce generation-aware splitting.
t_surface_evidence: Step 14 runs the optimizer and reports improvement ratios of 0.72x (cost worse), 0.96x (pad ratio worse), 0.93x (latency worse) for bucket 1, clearly showing the approach is already underperforming the baseline before t_commit.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks the domain knowledge that controlling G_max via generation-length-aware batch splitting is the key mechanism to reduce decode cost in the provided cost model (which scales decode cost quadratically with S_max and linearly with G_max per batch). Instead it repeatedly focuses on shape count and shape size as levers, which are secondary effects.
forewarning_evidence: Step 14 output shows cost INCREASED from 2.48e12 to 3.46e12 (0.72x), pad_ratio worsened (0.96x), and p95 latency worsened (0.93x) compared to baseline; this is a clear contradictory evidence signal before t_commit at step 16. Steps 17 and 20 repeat identical poor metrics, further reinforcing the forewarning.
